title: After Corona The Floods
summary:
China is getting hit by one natural disaster after another
China was the first country to be affected by the Corona virus in late 2019. In January 2020, the country instituted a lockdown of the Wuhan area, where most cases were occurring, and instituted travel restrictions. These measures lead to dramatic declines of demand for petroleum products such as jet fuel and gasoline.
